communications.subject: Freedom of Information Act Request: ORR Death Notifications
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Any notification, announcement, or Death in Custody Act worksheet of the in-custody death of a noncitizen minor held by ORR for U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement in ORR shelter or other settings for the period beginning January 1, 2025, and continuing through September 17, 2026.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Andrew Free

title: IPRA Request — Guadalupe County Jane Doe Homicide, July 11, 1978

communications.subject: New Mexico Inspection of Public Records Act Request: IPRA Request — Guadalupe County Jane Doe Homicide, July 11, 1978
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the New Mexico Inspection of Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

I am requesting records relating to the July 11, 1978 homicide of the unidentified female known as Guadalupe County Jane Doe (Agency Case Number: 1978-02998), a homicide associated with Ronald Eugene Lanphear.

The victim was reportedly identified through DNA testing in December 2024 as Judith A. Dow (born July 11, 1961).

For purposes of locating older records, the victim may appear under the designation Guadalupe County Jane Doe, Jane Doe, or another unidentified-female designation. More recent records may identify the victim as Judith A. Dow (DOB July 11, 1961).

I am requesting records sufficient to document:

•	The official identification of Guadalupe County Jane Doe as Judith A. Dow;
•	That DNA testing was used to confirm the victim's identity;
•	The date the identification was confirmed; and
•	The current or final status and disposition of the underlying homicide investigation, including any record indicating that the homicide was solved, cleared, closed, or otherwise concluded.

I am also requesting any records concerning Ronald Eugene Lanphear's involvement in the homicide, including records documenting his identification as a suspect or perpetrator, statements or admissions concerning the homicide, and the disposition of the case as it relates to him.

Please include records concerning the homicide's disposition following the victim's identification, including any documentation reflecting a change in the status of the case. 

If any portion of the requested records is exempt from disclosure, please provide all reasonably segregable non-exempt portions and identify the specific statutory basis for any withholding or redaction.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 15 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Rebekah Heath
